Mississauga sellers: your online estimate isn't your price.

Online estimates are computer guesses and can't see your upgrades or condition. Ask for recent sold prices of similar homes nearby, and ask how the price was set and what the plan is if offers are slow. Priced too high, a home may sit; too low, you may leave money on the table.

$700K home. How long to save the minimum down payment for a Brampton buyer?

Example only, simple arithmetic:
1) 5% of the first $500,000 = $25,000.
2) 10% of the next $200,000 = $20,000.
3) Minimum down payment = $25,000 + $20,000 = $45,000.
4) Saving $1,500 a month: $45,000 / $1,500 = 30 months, before interest.
Minimum down payment rule for homes priced $500,000 to $1,499,999: 5% of the first $500,000 plus 10% of the rest (CMHC). Closing costs are extra and lenders may ask for more.

Want help planning your down payment? Comment INFO to get full details, or call 905-452-4298.

Example only. Not mortgage, tax or legal advice.

Krishna Rander, Realtor® | PROPERTY.CA INC., Brokerage

frames.say: Brampton: seven hundred thousand dollar home. Down payment?

Next, ten percent of the other two hundred thousand dollars is twenty thousand dollars.
Then, divide forty-five thousand dollars by fifteen hundred a month.
So all in, about thirty months of saving fifteen hundred dollars a month.

Oakville buyer: your appraisal came in low. Now what?

1) Ask your lender what value it will lend on, in writing. 2) Work out the gap: price minus appraised value. You may need to cover it. 3) Ask your Realtor® about renegotiating the price before your condition date. 4) Watch your financing condition date: once it passes, you may still have to close at the agreed price.

Buying in Oakville? Comment INFO to get full details, or call 905-452-4298.

General information only. Lender rules vary. Not mortgage or legal advice.
